Package hadur117.twin.core

Class Team

java.lang.Object
hadur117.twin.core.Team
public final class Team extends Object
The team layer (docs/twinsaor.md section 4): who to shoot, where to stand, when to hold fire and how hard to fire. Pure statics on primitives (TWIN-3).

  • Method Details

    • switchTo

      public static boolean switchTo(double candidateEnergy, double targetEnergy)
      Whether the twins switch from the current target to a candidate (TWIN-7): when there is no live target yet, or the candidate has at least SWITCH_MARGIN less energy.
      Parameters:
      candidateEnergy - the candidate's energy
      targetEnergy - the current target's energy, or NaN without a live target
      Returns:
      true to switch

      public static double range(int enemiesAlive)

    • stationBearing

      public static double stationBearing(double tx, double ty, double midX, double midY, boolean leader)
      The bearing, from the target, of a twin's station (TWIN-9): 45 degrees either side of the bearing from the target to the team's midpoint, the leader on the clockwise side.
      Parameters:
      tx - the target's x
      ty - its y
      midX - the team's midpoint x
      midY - its y
      leader - whether this twin is the leader
      Returns:
      radians, Robocode's convention (0 north, clockwise)

    • point

      public static double[] point(double tx, double ty, double bearing, double range, int side)
      The point a twin drives to: on its station's bearing at range from the target, moved LEG across that line on the side side, and kept WALL px off every wall.
      Parameters:
      tx - the target's x
      ty - its y
      bearing - the station's bearing from the target
      range - px from the target
      side - +1 or -1, the end of the leg
      Returns:
      {x, y}

      public static boolean hold(double x, double y, double gunHeading, double targetDistance, double mateX, double mateY)

    • power

      public static double power(double energy, double distance, boolean mateAlive, int enemiesAlive)
      Bullet power: Saor's log10(energy) * 325 / distance, capped by mode. With the partner alive, 2.9 against two enemies and 3 against one; alone, Saor's end-game 1.9.
      Parameters:
      energy - our energy
      distance - the target's distance
      mateAlive - whether the partner lives
      enemiesAlive - enemies alive
      Returns:
      the power
